name: brain
description: Learns from every Claude Code session. Hooks record each session's prompts, failing tool calls, denied permissions, interrupts and token use to a local SQLite file, scrubbed. Reflection (off by default) drafts lessons from your corrections; loading (off by default) puts them in each session, where you forget or pin each one, and turns three on one tool into a skill. /brain:report shows the records.
